lines.text: In the last days the LORD's mountain will be raised above the hills, and many nations will come.
The nations say the God of Jacob will teach them His ways, and the law will go forth from Sinai.
The LORD will judge between peoples, and they will beat their swords into shields.
Each man will sit under his own vine and fig tree, and we will walk in the LORD's name.
The LORD will gather the lame and the outcast and will restore the former dominion to the watchtower.
